title: The OlmoEarth Platform: Geospatial inference at planetary scale
summary: OlmoEarth is a geospatial inference platform by AI2 that processes planetary-scale satellite imagery, combining a vision-language model with a distributed inference engine to enable efficient, scalable analysis of Earth observation data.
highlights: OlmoEarth enables geospatial inference at planetary scale, processing vast amounts of satellite imagery.
The platform integrates a vision-language model with a distributed inference engine for efficient analysis.
It is designed to handle Earth observation data at unprecedented scale, supporting diverse applications.
